summary: Add dormant tested iOS delivery and request-draft models for complete recovery integration.

replay.detail: No graph replay or data migration is required.

schema.detail: No server or wire schema changes. Internal answer outcomes distinguish refused and unconfirmed delivery and retain an explicit same-request check.

rules.detail: Only a guaranteed non-application permits another action identity. An authoritative closed item settles review without proving delivery of the earlier answer.

compatibility.detail: Existing answer.ts and its active store consumers remain unchanged. The new private answerDelivery module is consumed only by dormant model types/tests until per-item locking and Check delivery controls land together.

manual.detail: No new user interaction is introduced by the model-only change.

recovery.detail: The new model retains ambiguous delivery identity and requires a matching Completed receipt. Active runtime behavior is unchanged in this groundwork; its complete guarded consumer integration lands separately. Retained model checks are in memory only, not a process-durable outbox.
